welcome.dragHint: Drag and drop a folder from your file explorer
welcome.privacyHint: Your files stay on your computer • 100% offline analysis

toolbar.duplicatesNeedComplete: Available once the scan finishes — duplicate detection runs at the end

settings.title: Settings
settings.exportLogsHint: Save a .zip bundle of application logs and session diagnostics — useful when reporting a problem.
settings.windowEffectHint: Translucent window (vibrancy on macOS, acrylic on Windows). Turn off for a solid background.
settings.icicleLensHint: A lens that expands crowded regions of the icicle so tiny items become reachable.
settings.lensAggregateHint: Dormant while you browse; click a folded “+N” group to magnify into it.
settings.lensAlwaysHint: A magnifier follows your cursor whenever you hover the chart.
settings.icicleHeightHint: How rows use the available height.
settings.heightSmallHint: Compact rows that get thinner as folders pile up; hover for detail.
settings.heightComfortableHint: Roomier rows, still capped so shallow trees stay tidy.
settings.heightFillHint: Rows share the whole height so the chart always fills top-to-bottom (v4); hover for detail on deep trees.
settings.extensionsHint: Enable or disable optional features. Preferences are saved automatically.
settings.aiHint: Credentials for the LLM used to generate directory summaries. Stored only on this machine and sent to your endpoint; leave blank to use the LLM_BASE_URL / LLM_API_KEY environment variables.
settings.llmModelHint: OpenAI-compatible model identifier. Leave blank for the default.
settings.aiLocalHint: Runs a Qwen model entirely on this machine — private, offline, no API key. Pick a model and download it once.
settings.aiLocalDownloadError: Download failed. Check your connection and try again.
settings.aiDlErrTlsCert: The download server's security certificate was rejected — often a corporate network inspecting HTTPS traffic.
settings.aiDlErrDns: Couldn't resolve the download server (DNS). Check your network connection.
settings.aiDlErrConnect: Couldn't reach the download server — the connection timed out or was blocked (firewall).
settings.aiDlErrProxy: A network proxy requires authentication to reach the download server.
settings.aiDlErrHttp: The download server refused the request. Please try again later.
settings.aiDlErrDisk: Couldn't write the model to disk — check free space and permissions.
settings.aiDlErrNetworkHint: On a corporate or restricted network, a proxy, firewall or TLS inspection may be blocking the download.
settings.aiImportHint: Point to a local .gguf file. Large models may be slow or unstable on some GPUs.

details.selectFolderHint: Select this folder to load its summary.
details.waitingTurn: Another summary is being generated, this one is next…
details.aiUnavailableRuntime: AI summary unavailable — a required system component (Microsoft Visual C++ Runtime) is missing. Reinstall Archifiltre, or install the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable, to enable on-device summaries.
details.aiUnavailableModel: AI summary unavailable — the language model could not be loaded. Try re-downloading it in Settings.
details.aiUnavailableGeneric: AI summary unavailable — the on-device engine could not start. See the exported logs for details.

status.privacyOnDeviceHint: Your scan and its analysis run entirely on this computer. No file names or contents are sent over the network.
status.aiOnDeviceHint: On-device AI · {model} on {engine} — nothing leaves your computer.
status.aiUnavailableHint: On-device AI is unavailable — see the summary panel for details.
status.aiExternalDownHint: External AI endpoint unavailable — the last request could not be reached.
status.privacyExternal: Local · summaries sent to your endpoint
status.privacyExternalHint: The scan stays on this computer, but folder summaries are sent to the external LLM endpoint you configured in Settings › LLM.

skips.title: Not processed
skips.subtitle: Items that couldn't be fully read. Everything else was indexed.
skips.clickToShow: Click to show in the list

recovery.unopenableTitle: This scan's data couldn't be opened
recovery.unavailableHint: Its folder isn't available to rebuild it. Reconnect it and retry, or remove the scan.
recovery.restoreHint: {count} saved annotation(s) from a previous scan can be restored.
recovery.orphanedCount: {count} could not be restored (files no longer exist)

root.reportDesc: Download a generated report for this folder (.docx format).
root.duplicatesDesc: Review duplicate files to reclaim space.
